title: PROFESSIONAL SEMINAR IN MUSIC EDUCATION III
description: Continued interaction with field specialists and practitioners, and study of emerging topics and contemporary practices in music education. Fieldwork focuses on instructional strategies for guiding critical thinking and creative music listening.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: MUED 100.
A minimum grade of B- is required in MUED 100.
